messages.subject: Project Tempest - board approval and signing on 26-27 February
messages.plaintextBody:
Edward, Fiona, Grace,

We're on track for completion on 27 February. To get there we need the Wexford Holdings board to approve the restructuring documents - please hold 10.00am on 26 February for a short board meeting (Pavilion House / video). I'll circulate the board pack and the draft minutes today; the resolutions approve the A&R agreement, the intercreditor, the super-senior facility and the £4m shareholder contribution, and authorise signatories.

Donna will collect signature pages in escrow on the 26th to release on completion. Please let me know if anyone cannot make the meeting so we can arrange a written resolution instead.

Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
